name: Disruption gloves
description: Disruption gloves, also known as disruptor gloves, were a rare type of glove in use during a series of conflicts fought between the remnants of the Sith Empire and the Galactic Republic known as the Dark Wars. During unarmed combat, the gloves allowed a user to penetrate many types of defenses, including deflector shields.

data.name: Disruption gloves
data.purpose: Penetrating deflector shields in unarmed combat
